summary: Hinshelwood is sixth in Brighton's midfield pecking order by minutes (Groß, Gómez and Ayari start every week). High ceiling in the league's best attack if he gets back in; no sign of a league start at Hull.

claims.text: Came off the bench in the 78th minute of the 2-0 win over Brentford.
Projected in central midfield against Hull at 50% confidence.
Says he is working to get back into the starting line-up after his injury; no sign yet of a league start.
